Villagers Attempt 'Living Samadhi' Protest in Alwar, Stopped by Leader

In Alwar, Rajasthan, five villagers attempted to take a 'living samadhi' (burial alive) to protest against the government. The incident occurred in Bahadarpur and was prevented by the Leader of Opposition, Tika Ram Jully, who arrived at the scene. The villagers' specific grievances against the government were not detailed in the provided coverage.
